Finished the game and verified it in-browser.

### Completed
- Neon Drift arcade game is playable with:
  - Arrow keys / WASD steering
  - Space / Up / W phase dash
  - Asteroid, mine, and energy shard encounters
  - Hull damage and lives
  - Score, distance, best run, dash meter
  - Pause/resume
  - Restart after game over
  - Touch controls for mobile
  - Persistent best score via `localStorage`
- Fixed the mobile layout so the start screen no longer clips or overlaps the touch controls.
- Added responsive mobile game framing with a taller playfield.
- Verified desktop and mobile captures.
- Verified gameplay input, score updates, dash, and pause behavior with Playwright.

Changed file: `index.html`

Assumption: the existing neon asteroid-runner design was the intended game direction, so I preserved it and finished the responsive/playability polish rather than replacing the core game.
